qml: Item { function getRows(section) { const rows=Settings.data.bar.widgets[section]; return rows.slice(); } function edit(section) { var rows=getRows(section); rows.push({id:'x'}); } }

name: effectful local helper cannot lend a summary
qml: Item { function save(section,rows) { something(); Settings.data.bar.widgets[section]=rows; } function edit(section) { var rows=Settings.data.bar.widgets[section].slice(); rows.push({id:'x'}); save(section,rows); } }

name: live QML key stays review
qml: Item { property string section: source; function edit() { var rows=Settings.data.bar.widgets[section].slice(); rows.push({id:'x'}); Settings.data.bar.widgets[section]=rows; } }

name: screen argument captured before later argument effects
qml: Item { function edit(screen,other) { var widgets=Object.assign({},Settings.getScreenOverrideEntry(screen).widgets); widgets.left=[]; Settings.setScreenOverride(screen,'widgets',(screen=other,widgets)); } }

name: screen later argument cannot change captured destination
qml: Item { function edit(screen,other) { var widgets=Object.assign({},Settings.getScreenOverrideEntry(other).widgets); widgets.left=[]; Settings.setScreenOverride(screen,'widgets',(screen=other,widgets)); } }
